_note: FA 2026 s.2(4)(b) Table Sl. 10 (p.7) and s.3(4)(b) Table Sl. 10 (pp.13–14), for an individual: "(i) Where the total income (including dividend income or capital gains under the provisions of sections 111A, 112 and 112A [s.3: 196, 197 and 198]) exceeds Rs. 50,00,000 but does not exceed Rs. 1,00,00,000, at the rate of ten per cent.; (ii) … exceeds Rs. 1,00,00,000 but does not exceed Rs. 2,00,00,000, at the rate of fifteen per cent.; … (iv) where the total income (including …) exceeds Rs. 2,00,00,000, but is not covered in clause (iii) at the rate of fifteen per cent." Clauses (ii) and (iv) are the open-ended 15% band. The surcharge rate is not marginal: the band the income falls in sets one rate for the whole tax; W-056 looks the band up and takes the greater of this row's rate and the -EXCLUDING row's (D-084). The limit on the tax attributable to dividend income and the special gains (15%) is the -LIMIT row (rulebook RATE-SUR-SPLIT-001; W-088c, D-246); the excluding income is total income less dividend income and the special-rate capital gains. Spans TY 2025-26 (s.2, AY 2026-27) and TY 2026-27 (s.3): the same figures.
